primary_denominator: all full-target actions; never only checked subset or method-specific ablation gold
bootstrap: paired/base-group resampling, 1000 repeats, seed17; same all-target denominator as coverage

structural_dedup.interpretation: Exact structural equality only; not semantic novelty evidence

new800_extras.crash_policy: Crashes/invalid results are separate; only a defined wrong action counts as sensitivity

interpretation.primary: Direct whole native elapsed with diagnostics off includes necessary state/store plus common collector
interpretation.selected: Selected checkpoint collection+guard is a component, not complete working overhead; necessary sidecar work outside checks is not partitioned
interpretation.unselected: Common adapter extra collection at unselected checkpoints; separately shown, not attributed to each method rule cost
interpretation.trim: Per-request elapsed minus unselected collection, then quantiles: conditional engineering estimate, not measured optimized implementation
interpretation.diagnostic: Optional snapshot-copy span measured directly; not a substitute for necessary store work
interpretation.off_difference: Paired by repeat/diagnostics/case; STOP difference includes avoided work and is not equal-work overhead
interpretation.cold: Separate-process safe first response includes imports/fixture setup; each method/mode has one cold observation, reused as reference in HOLD table
interpretation.scope: Scripted model stub, isolated SQLite, real in-process FinStripe. No real model latency or API savings estimate

audit_caveats.component_scope: A05 HOLD states; aggregate BLOCK unchanged
audit_caveats.independent_audit: See separate final-audit.json/final-audit.md; they are not statistical producer inputs and are not hashed here
